vendor_findings.bolt_and_nut_m3_post_torx_heads: Only two M3 post-Torx T10 products in the Security Fasteners > Machine Screws category (28 products listed): countersunk and button. No pan, cheese or flange post-Torx in M3 (VERIFIED from the category listing).

csk.pack_note: industry pack 100; sold per piece with tier pricing

cup_washer_6g.status: VERIFIED spec and price; fit of an M3 CSK head (5.90) in a 6g cup is by geometry, not tested

bit.spec: T10 x 25 mm post-Torx insert bit, 1/4 in hex

l_key.spec: T10 post-Torx L-key, length 90, short arm 19, alloy tool steel

plain_torx_pan_alternative.spec: M3 pan head Torx T10 (no pin), A4-70 G316, ISO 14583, dk 5.70-6.00, k 2.28-2.52; LIMITED STOCK 10000 / 2500
plain_torx_pan_alternative.status: VERIFIED; only for H8 if a cut-down post key will not fit

nylon_washer.status: VERIFIED; not needed in the recommended schedule

vendor_findings.not_at_bolt_and_nut: No PCB spacers/standoffs category in the site navigation (spacers stay Wurth via Digi-Key). Site search is client-rendered and could not be read: M3x22 or longer button post-Torx not found in any category.

wurth_971100321.spec: M3 hex standoff M/F, steel zinc, 5.5 AF, body 10, overall 16 (male 6)
wurth_971100321.female_thread_depth: UNVERIFIED: an RS listing (search snippet) gives "hole depth 10 mm"; Wurth datasheet 403, Farnell timed out

sites.names: LidScrew_1..11 (9 shell bosses + 2 into the woofer-chamber insert roof)
sites.current: M3x10 countersunk post-Torx T10 (CAD v15, already converted)
sites.head: countersunk 90 deg, flush in a 6.0 x 90 countersink
sites.stack: lid 4.0 (head flush); insert top at the lid inner face; pilot 8.0

recommended.engagement: 6.0 thread, insert full, tip 2.0 above the pilot floor

sites.names: DrvScrew_L1..L4, R1..R4 (Dayton ND65-4, rear-mounted on the 11 mm pads)
sites.current: M3x10 countersunk post-Torx T10 on an UNSOURCED 8 x 1.6 cup washer (CAD v15)
sites.head: countersunk on a cup washer (the 0.75 mm flange cannot be countersunk)
sites.stack: cup washer (head top about 1.75 above the flange) + ND65 flange 0.75; insert top at the pad face; pilot 10
sites.insert: Ruthex M3x5.7 in the 11 mm pad, pilot 10

recommended.part: CSK post-Torx M3x10 + Bolt and Nut 6g stainless cup washer 71CS6 (11.2 x 2.2)
recommended.engagement: about 7.5 thread below the pad face (+-0.3 for the cup seat), insert full, tip about 2.5 above the pilot floor

sites.change: CAD: cup washer model 8.0 x 1.6 -> 11.2 OD x 2.2; check the 5.7 mm washer radius against the ND65 basket ribs next to each hole (hole centre 8.6 from the flange edge)
sites.note: A button head straight on the flange is NOT acceptable: dk 5.11 min on a 4.2 hole leaves a 0.45 mm bearing ring on a 0.75 mm flange.

sites.names: PcbScrew H1..H9, HA1, HA2 (all on the woofer-chamber insert roof/shelf, insert top z 57.0)
sites.current: ISO 4762 socket M3x16 (hex) through a Wurth 970100321 10 mm F/F hex spacer into the roof insert
sites.head: -> button post-Torx (no pan/cheese post-Torx in M3 at Bolt and Nut)
sites.stack: head, PCB 1.6, 10 mm spacer, insert in the roof (pilot 6.7, bosses below the roof)

a_button_M3x16_through_10mm_spacer.note: same 4.4 mm as today; a threaded F/F spacer is screwed through, so the spacer is not clamped to the roof (an unthreaded spacer is the correct part); the only site needing 16

b_6mm_spacer_M3x12.cad_change: board drops 4 mm: every lid cutout (USB-C, jacks, SW100, TC2030 access), the knob dish depth and shaft exposure move; M3x10 would need a 4 mm spacer (board -6 mm)
b_6mm_spacer_M3x12.verdict: rejected: still not 10 mm, large CAD change

c_printed_10mm_boss_on_roof_M3x10.cad_change: boss 10 high OD 8 with the insert at its top (pilot 9.4); the under-roof bosses go (+about 2.6 cm3 chamber volume)
c_printed_10mm_boss_on_roof_M3x10.verdict: rejected: the insert prints roof-down (roof top on the bed), so a boss above the roof cannot be printed with it; separate glued posts take the screw torque in a glue joint

d_MF_standoff_Wurth_971100321_button_M3x.stud: male 6 into the 5.7 insert (insert full, 0.7 above the 6.7 pilot floor)
d_MF_standoff_Wurth_971100321_button_M3x.cad_change: model swap only: same 5.5 AF x 10 body envelope; the stud replaces the screw shank in the insert; head 5.7 x 1.8 instead of 5.5 x 3.0
d_MF_standoff_Wurth_971100321_button_M3x.verdict: RECOMMENDED: M3x10 everywhere on the PCB, steel thread for the PCB screw, the stud preloads the spacer onto the insert; condition: female thread >= 8.5 (RS listing hole depth 10, UNVERIFIED); fallback M3x8 (6.4 mm) if shorter

recommended.part: Wurth 971100321 M/F standoff (10 + 6) + button post-Torx M3x10
recommended.engagement: stud: insert full; screw: 8.4 mm in the steel female thread (check depth on arrival)

sites.access: H8 is under the knob dish floor: 11.7 mm from the button head top (z 70.4) to the dish floor (z 82.09). The T10 post L-key short arm is 19 mm and the bit 25 mm: neither fits. Cut a second L-key short arm to about 8 mm, or use the plain-Torx pan M3x10 (21PTS310M) at H8 with a ball-end T10 key (not at Bolt and Nut). The other ten holes have about 26.6 mm above the head: the 19 mm key fits.

sites.names: WoofScrew_1..4 (Tang Band W3-2052SC, square frame, 68.25 mm hole square)
sites.current: ISO 4762 socket M3x20 (hex), not on the buy list
sites.head: -> button post-Torx M3x20 (longest M3 button post-Torx at Bolt and Nut)
sites.stack: head on the frame back; frame block 13.3 + factory gasket 3.3 (photo estimates +-1.5); insert top at the floor inner face (seat); pilot 6.7, skin 1.0, outside boss 4.7 below the floor
sites.insert: Ruthex M3x5.7 in the floor + outside teardrop boss, pilot 6.7
sites.m3x25_note: 25 exists only as a discontinued countersunk (no seat for a countersink on the frame) and would need pilot 10.4 / outside bosses 8.4 deep

tweak.description: four 2.0 mm high, OD 7.0 bosses on the floor inner face at the screw axes (insert top raised 2.0), 7.5 mm holes punched in the factory gasket at the screws, pilot 7.7 from the boss top, outside bosses 4.7 -> 3.7 below the floor
tweak.conditions: gasket keeps >= 6 mm of seal band inside the bosses (bolt corner radius 48.26 vs aperture 38.1); bosses must stay below the compressed gasket height; caliper the frame and gasket first

recommended.engagement: 3.4 free / 4.4 compressed as drawn; 5.4 / 5.7 (full) with the 2 mm boss tweak

sites.current: Wurth 971120321 M/F stud (12 + 6) into a floor insert + 3M SJ5312 bumpon
sites.head: hex body, no drive recess

sites.names: rocker SW101, grommet, grilles, strap, chamber insert, knob, wiring
sites.current: SW101 snap-in (fastons), Heyco 2000 snap bushing, grilles and chamber insert bonded with Sikaflex, hook-and-loop strap through printed tunnels, knob grub screw supplied with the Jaycar HK7011 knob, wires routed free (no clips in CAD v15)

owner_decisions: PCB: approve option (d) Wurth 971100321 M/F + button M3x10 (all 10 mm) or keep option (a) button M3x16 through the existing spacer (one 16 mm length, no Digi-Key change)
Woofer: accept button M3x20 (3.4-4.4 mm, as today) or add the 2 mm floor-boss tweak (5.4-5.7 mm) after calipering the frame and gasket

H8: cut a second L-key (short arm about 8 mm) or use a plain-Torx pan M3x10 (21PTS310M, limited stock) with a ball-end T10 key
Buy quantity: one unit with spares (as listed) or the 50-piece CSK tier (AUD 21.00) for two units
